metadata.description: Official Metabase documentation links for API automation, Agent API, Remote Sync, embedding, tenants, permissions, and release tracking.
metadata.title: Data Metabase - Sources

trust_tiers.primary: Official project, vendor, standards, or source documentation. Prefer for factual claims and current behavior.
trust_tiers.secondary: Tutorials, landscape reports, community references, and implementation examples. Use for framing after checking primary sources.

metadata.default_source_policy: Use current Metabase docs first for endpoint shapes, auth, plan availability, Remote Sync, embedding, Agent API, and release-sensitive UI surfaces. Use Learn/tutorial pages for implementation context only.

releases_and_secondary.name: Metabase releases page
releases_and_secondary.relevance: Canonical release index. v59 (Mar 2026): Data Studio, AI SQL in OSS. v60 (Apr 2026): official MCP server, Metabot in Slack, AI open-sourced. v61 (May 2026): AI governance, dashboards-as-code. v62 (Jun 2026, current): official Metabase CLI, MCP SQL/collection-write + interactive charts, Schema Viewer, custom visualizations, Alert Management hub, Library sub-collections. v63 reported in beta as of Jul 2026. Verify /docs/latest before citing specific behavior.

releases_and_secondary.name: Metabase GitHub repository
releases_and_secondary.relevance: Source of truth for edge-case behavior and API internals when docs are ambiguous.

releases_and_secondary.name: Metabase MCP server documentation
releases_and_secondary.relevance: Official MCP server (v60+): connects Metabase to Claude, Cursor, VS Code, and other MCP clients. Enables dashboards-as-code from AI terminals (v61+). As of v62, can execute SQL, create collections, and render interactive charts in the AI client. Same permissions as authenticated user.

releases_and_secondary.name: AI in Metabase documentation
releases_and_secondary.relevance: Entry point for all AI features: Metabot, Agent API, MCP server, AI settings, and AI governance (v61+). Covers plan availability and per-feature access controls.

releases_and_secondary.name: MBQL Reference (GitHub Wiki, legacy)
releases_and_secondary.relevance: Legacy reference for MBQL concepts. Useful as a secondary source, but treat it as incomplete and confirm against exported payloads.
